mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id FROM merchants WHERE status = 'active' AND #{normalizedApprovalName} LIKE CONCAT(normalized_name, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(normalized_name) DESC, merchant_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.merchant_id FROM merchant_aliases a INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = a.merchant_id AND m.status = 'active' WHERE #{normalizedApprovalName} LIKE CONCAT(a.normalized_alias_name, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(a.normalized_alias_name) DESC, a.merchant_alias_id ASC LIMIT 1
